description: Request a Global CDN cache purge (invalidation). Purge whole content or specific files. isWholeDomain/isWholePurge select scope.

cdnInstanceNo.description: Global CDN instance number to purge

isWholeDomain.description: true: purge across all domains; false: only domains in serviceDomainNameList

isWholePurge.description: true: purge all files; false: only targetFileList

serviceDomainNameList.description: Service domain names to purge (required when isWholeDomain=false)

targetFileList.description: Specific file paths to purge (required when isWholePurge=false)

name: ncloud_globalcdn_request_purge
